description: This file is a BitBake include file (.inc) used in Yocto/OpenEmbedded build system for configuring the BusyBox package. It contains package metadata, dependencies, configuration definitions, build and installation functions, and post-installation scripts specific to busybox.

classes.name: bb.utils
classes.description: Utility methods for feature detection in BitBake recipes.

methods.name: busybox_cfg
methods.description: Configures busybox build options based on features.

methods.name: features_to_busybox_settings
methods.description: Maps distro features to busybox configuration options.

methods.name: features_to_busybox_del
methods.description: Generates commands to remove busybox features.

methods.name: do_prepare_config
methods.description: Prepares the busybox configuration before building.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configure step for busybox build, including feature configuration.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles busybox, handling split SUID configuration if enabled.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs busybox binaries and related configuration files, with handling for different build options.
